description: Reads a researcher's whole publication record from OpenAlex (and their public ORCID record): how many papers, total citations, mean and median field-weighted citation impact (FWCI, where 1.0 is the world average), h-index, papers in their field's top 10% and top 1%, any retracted paper, and their highest-impact papers. Give an ORCID iD or an OpenAlex author id; a name returns the matching profiles to choose from.

researcher.description: An ORCID iD (0000-0002-1825-0097), an OpenAlex author id (A5023888391), or a name.

name: check_researcher
title: Check a researcher's record
